description: The date a departure deadline runs out, from our deadline register and the date the person left or died, with the official source and read date. Where the start event depends on the person's circumstances, the date is an estimate and says what to confirm. Nothing is stored.

country.description: The country left: ISO code or English name, for example JP or Japan.

date.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD, not after today.

event.description: "left" or "died". Optional when the country has only one.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

name: deadline_check
title: When does a departure deadline run out
